correctness.rationale: The sole operations are bounded Heyting lattice/implication and global min/max. The set of all term entries stays within endpoints plus initial entries; Boolean zero sets are preserved by meet, join, implication and global quantifiers. Distinct positivity words make every crisp coordinate selector definable by Godel negation/double negation; applying existential maximum to a masked generator entry produces the required diagonal scalar constant. The selectors and these constants construct every element. Inclusion-exclusion over k-2 intermediate levels with n distinct Hamming words gives N_{k,n,r}, and maximizing positive slots gives the exact rank capacity T_r(n). Independently enumerated actual generated subalgebras agree with criterion and counts, including N_{5,2,2}=24.
risk: Bounded checks do not replace unrestricted logical or algebraic proof.
